description: One year of the annual filings: the VZ, the EZ or the year the fiscal year ends in.

fields.description: The Erklärungen of the year are due on the last day of February of the second year after it (§ 149 Abs. 3 AO); USt 2 A line 127, KSt 1 line 100.
fields.label: Prepared by a Steuerberatung

fields.description: No Umsatzsteuererklärung for the year (§ 19 Abs. 1 UStG).
fields.label: Kleinunternehmer

fields.description: The company states, as agreed with its Steuerberatung, that it owes no Umsatzsteuererklärung for the year. Steuerbote takes the statement as given and does not judge the status for VAT.
fields.label: No Umsatzsteuererklärung Owed
Reason Why None Is Owed
fields.options:
Not an Unternehmer (§ 2 UStG)
Released by the Finanzamt
Other Reason

fields.description: The reference of the statement of the Finanzamt, such as its letter and date; for Other Reason what the reason is.
fields.label: Reference and Note

fields.description: The day the Finanzamt set for the Erklärung under § 149 Abs. 4 AO, instead of the deadline.
fields.label: Asked Early: Umsatzsteuererklärung

fields.description: The day the shareholders adopted the Jahresabschluss of the fiscal year ending in this year (§ 42a Abs. 2 GmbHG). The Jahresabschluss writes it.
fields.label: Jahresabschluss Adopted on

fields.description: A subsidiary in the Konzernabschluss of its parent that meets § 264 Abs. 3 HGB discloses no Jahresabschluss of its own.
fields.label: Exempt under § 264 Abs. 3 HGB
